items.title: CVE-2026-82355: Apache Airflow: Session cookie silently overrides explicit Authorization bearer header, enabling session fixation
items.one_liner: Airflow operators on versions 3.3.0 and 3.3.1 must upgrade to 3.3.2 to prevent session cookie precedence from hijacking API bearer requests.
items.summary: Apache Airflow versions 3.3.0 and 3.3.1 suffer from a session fixation and principal confusion vulnerability (CVE-2026-82355) where a session cookie silently overrides an explicit Authorization bearer token. When requests contain both credentials, Airflow resolves the principal from the cookie rather than the token, causing audit logs to misattribute actions. Exploitation requires an attacker to place a valid session cookie into the victim's browser via subdomain cookie tossing or XSS. Users must upgrade to Airflow 3.3.2 or later.
items.bottom_line: Apache Airflow 3.3.0/3.3.1 allows session cookies to silently override bearer headers, causing identity misattribution.

items.one_liner: Researchers evaluate methods for efficient recurring benchmarking of production LLM agents, highlighting adaptive testing and fixed subsets.

items.title: Can Agents Design Better Chips with a Higher Level Abstraction?
items.one_liner: Combining High-Level Synthesis abstractions with RTL refinement enables LLM agents to achieve a 2.6x speedup in chip design.
items.summary: Researchers evaluated whether large language model agents can design superior chips by using higher-level abstractions rather than directly writing register-transfer level (RTL) code. They compared Direct RTL Design, Agent-based HLS Design, Post-Compiler HLS Refinement, and Post-HLS RTL Refinement, introducing AHRR (Agent-based HLS with RTL Refinement) which combines HLS design with RTL refinement. Using FPGAs across an 11-task benchmark suite, AHRR achieved a geometric-mean speedup of 2.6x over Direct RTL Design. Case studies demonstrated that High-Level Synthesis (HLS) distills design knowledge into manageable abstractions for agents, while subsequent RTL refinement captures low-level optimizations.
items.bottom_line: Leveraging higher-level abstractions through HLS combined with RTL refinement allows LLM agents to design better chips faster.

items.title: Scaling Discovery through Test-Time Communication

items.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that multi-agent systems using test-time communication significantly outperform independent agents on complex tasks.
